description: This file defines a class 'registry_v3' that extends 'registry' to register service functions and complex data types for the SuiteCRM v3 SOAP API. It includes method registration for various operations like fetching module fields, available modules, last viewed items, upcoming activities, searching modules, and relationships, along with the registration of corresponding complex types used in the service interface.

classes.name: registry_v3
classes.description: A class extending the base 'registry' to define SOAP API functions and complex types for SuiteCRM v3, including registration of service functions and data types.

methods.name: registerFunction
methods.description: Registers the service functions available in the API, such as get_module_fields_md5, get_available_modules, get_last_viewed, etc.

methods.name: registerTypes
methods.description: Registers complex data types used in the SOAP API, such as md5_results, module_names, upcoming_activities_list, etc.
